## IV. Proposed subpoena duces tecum — No. 2 (to Salvador Osum dela Fuente, as collector)

**TO:** SALVADOR OSUM DELA FUENTE, Purok 5, Brgy. VII, Daet, Camarines Norte (address per his Judicial Affidavit, p.2 [VERIFY]).

**YOU ARE COMMANDED** to appear before this Court at ________ on ________, at ____ a.m./p.m., and to bring the following, if under your control:

1. **The complete receipt booklets** printed "HEIRS OF MARY W. KEESEY ESTATE / Vicente Basit Extension, Daet, Cams. Norte / TIN-160-902-582-Non Vat", serial series "0001-1250", including:
   - (a) every unused receipt;
   - (b) every **duplicate and triplicate copy and every stub**, whether issued, cancelled or voided;
   - (c) the **booklet covers and back pages**, showing the printer's name and address and any BIR Authority to Print or permit number and date.
2. **The generic receipt pads** from which the other receipts in Defendants' Exhibit "5" were issued (dated 2003 to 2012), with their stubs, duplicates and covers.
3. **Any collection ledger, notebook, list, logbook or summary** of payments received from any occupant or buyer of any part of the land covered by TCT No. T-4497 or its derivative titles, from 1992 to 2017, including any record of turnover of collections to Cesar M. de la Fuente (Judicial Affidavit, Q&A 23–24).
4. **Any document showing your authority** to collect payments or sign receipts for the heirs of Mary W. Keesey, or for Cesar M. de la Fuente.
5. **Records of the real property tax and estate tax payments** you state you made from collections (Judicial Affidavit, Q&A 24–25): official receipts and the records showing the source of the funds.
6. **Any record of the Taxpayer Identification Number 160-902-582**, showing in whose name it was registered.

**Fees tendered:** witness fees for one day, kilometrage, and the reasonable cost of production (Rule 21, Sec. 6), in the amount of ₱________ [counsel to compute].

**Warning** [VERIFY 2019 text]: Rule 21, Section 9: "Failure by any person without adequate cause to obey a subpoena served upon him shall be deemed a contempt of the court from which the subpoena is issued."

[Signature block for the Clerk of Court / Judge — blank]
